data.one_liner: Cross‑platform Flutter plugin for reading 1D/2D barcodes from images or raw frames.
data.what_it_does: It wraps the Dynamsoft Barcode Reader SDK to decode a wide range of barcode symbologies on Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux. The plugin is camera‑agnostic, so you feed it image files or pixel buffers from any camera source.
use_when: You need barcode scanning on multiple platforms from a single code base
You already use a custom camera plugin and only need decoding logic
avoid_when: You require a fully integrated camera‑preview + scanning solution out of the box
You cannot obtain a Dynamsoft license key
strengths: Supports all major platforms including web and desktop
Broad set of supported barcode formats
Decoding runs on background threads, not blocking UI
weaknesses: Requires a paid license for production use
Not a complete camera solution, must be paired with another plugin
data.setup_notes: Add Dynamsoft license key in code; Android minSdk 21; iOS/macOS add camera usage keys and entitlements; macOS bundle Dynamsoft Templates/Models resources; Web serve over HTTPS for WASM
